`regcode0=18559846`

### N:

`9324997475922363642620858951` (10进制)

`111100010000101110101000001100001011101000001100001101011000000011111110100101101001001000111` (2进制)

### D:

`1013612126791590267622808303`

`34670B77F0A8CEA34085AEF`

`110100011001110000101101110111111100001010100011001110101000110100000010000101101011101111`

`regcode6=175003FFCBA3E2E7FE703602`

按每 2 位查表：`table[0x17]=0x18`, `table[0x50]=0x47`, ..., `table[0x02]=0x01`

得 `M=184703F6CBA9E2E7F7703601`

`"000110000100011100000011111101101100101110101001111000101110011111110111011100000011011000000001"`

由 `C = (M ^ D) mod N`

`RSAdec(regcode6)=RSAdec(184703F6CBA9E2E7F7703601)=73138353539383436`

`73138353539383436`

`"1110011000100111000001101010011010100111001001110000011010000110110"`

去掉“111”得

`"0011000100111000001101010011010100111001001110000011010000110110"`

即 `3138353539383436` 转化为字符串为 `"18559846"`

与 `regcode0="18559846"` 比较，相等则注册成功
